method: Fetched the GitHub branch to FETCH_HEAD; git show read back every manifest-listed blob; compared remote byte length and SHA-256 to the local manifest; independently read back the manifest and candidate DOCX bytes.
note: A stale local origin/<branch> tracking ref was first queried and did not contain the new commit; that readback attempt was discarded. FETCH_HEAD and git ls-remote both resolved the actual remote head to the package commit above, and all 68 entries then matched.
